page.terms.title: Terms & Conditions
page.terms.subtitle: The simple rules for using CULTRAVEN and buying from us.
page.terms.metaDescription: CULTRAVEN Terms & Conditions: how orders, payments, delivery, returns and accounts work when you shop with us.
page.terms.intro: Please read these terms before you use cultraven.com or place an order. By using the website or buying from us, you agree to them. We have kept the language simple on purpose.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body:
CULTRAVEN is an Indian clothing brand run as a proprietorship from Indore, Madhya Pradesh. We sell oversized t-shirts, hoodies, cargos and other streetwear at cultraven.com.

- **Business name:** CULTRAVEN
- **Address:** 162, Jay Shri Nagar, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452005
- **GSTIN:** 23BJHPH4892N1ZQ
- **Email:** [support@cultraven.com](mailto:support@cultraven.com)
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** [+91 89622 12605](tel:+918962212605), Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM IST

You must be 18 or older to place an order. If you are younger, please ask a parent or guardian to order for you.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body:
- Give us correct details when you sign up (name, email, phone number) and keep them up to date.
- Keep your password private. You are responsible for what happens on your account.
- Tell us straight away at [support@cultraven.com](mailto:support@cultraven.com) if you think someone else is using it.
- You can change your details or delete your account any time from **Account → Profile**.
- We can pause or close an account that is used for fraud, fake orders or abuse.

sections.heading: Products and prices
sections.body:
- All prices are in Indian Rupees (₹) and include GST.
- Colours can look slightly different on your screen than in real life. We try to show them as true as we can.
- Stock is limited. A product can sell out at any time.
- We can change prices at any time. A price change never affects an order you have already placed.
- If a price or stock detail is clearly wrong (a typing mistake, for example), we may cancel the order and refund you in full.

sections.heading: Placing an order
sections.body:
When you place an order you are asking to buy. **Your order is confirmed when you get our order confirmation email.** Until then it is not final.

We may refuse or cancel an order if the item is out of stock, the price was shown wrongly, we cannot deliver to your pincode, the payment cannot be verified, or we suspect fraud. If we cancel, we tell you by email and refund anything you paid.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body:
- **Cash on Delivery (COD):** available for orders up to ₹5,000 in pincodes we serve. A COD fee of ₹49 is added at checkout. You pay the courier when the order arrives.
- **Online payment:** UPI, cards and net banking through Razorpay, whenever online payments are switched on. We never see or store your card details. Razorpay handles them.
- If money is taken from your account but you see no order, please wait a few minutes and then contact us before paying again, so you are not charged twice.
- The total shown at checkout (items, delivery fee, COD fee, discounts) is the final amount you pay.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.body:
We deliver across India. Delivery is free on orders above ₹1,999. Below that, a delivery fee of ₹99 applies. Standard delivery takes 4 to 6 business days after dispatch.

Delivery dates are estimates, not promises. Weather, strikes and courier delays can cause late deliveries. We are not responsible for delays or failed deliveries caused by a wrong or incomplete address. Ownership of the product passes to you when it is delivered. Full details are in our [Shipping policy](/pages/shipping).

sections.heading: Cancelling an order
sections.body:
You can cancel your own order from **Account → Orders** within 7 days of placing it.

- **Before it is dispatched:** the cancellation happens straight away.
- **After it is dispatched:** you send a cancellation request, and we check with the courier.

If you paid online, your refund goes back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

sections.heading: Returns, exchanges and refunds
sections.body:
- You can return an order within **7 days of delivery** if the items are unworn, unwashed and have their original tags.
- Size exchanges are allowed within **15 days of delivery**, depending on stock.
- **Sale and clearance items cannot be returned.** If a sale piece arrives wrong or damaged, tell us and we will sort it out.
- Refunds are paid within 5 to 7 business days after the returned item reaches us and passes a quick check. They go back to your original payment method. For COD orders we ask for your UPI ID or bank details.

The full process is on our [Returns & Exchanges](/pages/returns) page.

sections.heading: Using the website properly
Our brand and content
sections.body: The CULTRAVEN name, logo, designs, graphics, photos, text and website code belong to us or to people who license them to us. You may use them to browse and shop. You may not copy, sell or reuse them without our written permission.

sections.heading: Other websites and services
sections.body: Our website links to services we do not run, such as Instagram, Razorpay and courier tracking pages. They have their own rules. We are not responsible for what they do or say.

sections.heading: Our responsibility
sections.body:
We work hard to keep the website and your orders running smoothly, but we cannot promise it will always be available or free of errors.

As far as the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or knock-on losses, and our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid for the order in question. **Nothing here limits your rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019** or any other law that cannot be limited.

sections.heading: Your privacy
sections.body: How we collect and use your personal information is explained in our [Privacy Policy](/pages/privacy). It forms part of these terms.

sections.heading: Complaints and Grievance Officer
sections.body:
If something goes wrong, write to us first. We want to fix it.

- **Grievance Officer:** Customer Support, CULTRAVEN
- **Email:** [support@cultraven.com](mailto:support@cultraven.com)
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** [+91 89622 12605](tel:+918962212605), Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM IST
- **Address:** 162, Jay Shri Nagar, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452005

We acknowledge every complaint within 48 hours and aim to resolve it within one month, as required by the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms follow the laws of India. If a dispute cannot be settled by talking, the courts at Indore, Madhya Pradesh will have jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows the latest version. If you keep using the website after a change, you accept the new terms. Orders already placed stay under the terms that applied when you placed them.

page.terms.contactText: Write to us and a real person will reply.

page.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
page.privacy.subtitle: What we collect, why we collect it, and the control you have.
page.privacy.metaDescription: CULTRAVEN Privacy Policy: what personal data we collect, how we use and protect it, who we share it with, and your rights.
page.privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains in plain words what information CULTRAVEN collects when you use cultraven.com, what we do with it, and how you can control it. We follow the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

sections.heading: Who is responsible for your data
sections.body: CULTRAVEN, 162, Jay Shri Nagar, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452005, is responsible for the personal information described here. You can reach us any time at [support@cultraven.com](mailto:support@cultraven.com) or [+91 89622 12605](tel:+918962212605).

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body:
**Things you give us**

- **Account details:** your name, email address, phone number and password. We never store your password as readable text. It is scrambled (hashed) so even we cannot read it.
- **Order details:** the items you buy, your delivery address, phone number and email, and whether you pay by COD or online.
- **Optional details:** a profile photo, saved addresses, and your wishlist.
- **Messages:** anything you send us through the contact form, email, WhatsApp or chat.

**Things we collect automatically**

- Basic device and visit information such as browser type, pages you view and your IP address.
- Cookies that keep you signed in and remember your cart (see the Cookies section).

**Payments:** online payments are handled by Razorpay. **We never see or store your card number, UPI PIN or net banking password.**

sections.heading: Why we use your information
sections.body:
- To take, pack, deliver and bill your orders, and to handle returns and refunds.
- To create and protect your account, and to sign you in safely.
- To send you emails about your orders and account: order confirmations, shipping updates, receipts and password resets.
- To answer your questions and help you when something goes wrong.
- To spot and stop fraud, fake orders and misuse.
- To improve the website, our products and the shopping experience.
- To meet legal duties, such as tax and accounting rules.
- To send you offers or news about new drops, **only if you agree**. You can say no at any time.

sections.heading: Emails we send
sections.body:
Emails about your orders and your account (confirmation, updates, receipts, password reset and security notices) are part of the service, so you will get them while you have an order or an account. Marketing emails are optional and every one of them has a way to stop receiving them.

Our emails come from orders@cultraven.com and support@cultraven.com. If an email you expected is missing, please check your Spam folder.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
sections.body:
**We do not sell your personal information.** We share it only when it is needed to run the shop:

- **Courier and delivery partners:** your name, address and phone number, so they can deliver your parcel.
- **Razorpay:** to process online payments, when you choose to pay online.
- **Service providers who work for us:** website hosting (Vercel), our database (MongoDB Atlas) and email (Google Workspace). They may only use your data to provide that service to us.
- **Analytics:** Google Analytics, only if you accept cookies.
- **Authorities:** when the law or a valid court or government order requires it.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body:
Cookies are small files saved on your device.

- **Essential cookies** keep you signed in and remember your cart. The site cannot work without them.
- **Analytics cookies** help us see which pages people use. We only turn these on after you press **Accept** on our cookie banner.

You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential cookies, sign-in and the cart may not work.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body:
- **Your account details:** for as long as your account is active.
- **Orders, receipts and invoices:** up to 8 years, because tax and accounting laws require it.
- **Support messages:** as long as needed to help you and to settle any dispute.
- **Password reset and security links:** they expire quickly, and a reset link works only once.

**If you delete your account:** you can no longer sign in, your profile photo is removed, and your email address is freed so you can sign up again. We keep your order records and a copy of your original email address only for accounting, legal and fraud-prevention reasons.

sections.heading: How we protect it
sections.body:
- The whole website uses HTTPS, so what you send us is encrypted on the way.
- Passwords are stored hashed, never as plain text.
- Card and UPI details stay with Razorpay and are not stored by us.
- Only the people who need your data to do their job can see it, and our admin area needs a secure sign-in.

No website can promise perfect security. If you ever suspect a problem with your account, tell us right away and change your password.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body:
You can ask us to:

- **Show you** the personal information we hold about you.
- **Correct** anything that is wrong or out of date.
- **Delete** your account and personal information (subject to the records we must keep by law).
- **Stop** marketing emails or take back a consent you gave.

You can fix most things yourself in **Account → Profile**. For anything else, email [support@cultraven.com](mailto:support@cultraven.com). We reply as soon as we can, and within 30 days at most.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: CULTRAVEN is meant for people aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If you think a child has given us their details, tell us and we will delete them.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows the latest version. If we make an important change, we will tell you by email or with a notice on the website.

sections.heading: Contact and complaints
sections.body:
For any privacy question or complaint, contact our Grievance Officer (Customer Support):

- **Email:** [support@cultraven.com](mailto:support@cultraven.com)
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** [+91 89622 12605](tel:+918962212605), Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM IST
- **Address:** 162, Jay Shri Nagar, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452005

We acknowledge complaints within 48 hours and aim to resolve them within one month.

page.privacy.contactText: Ask us anything. We will answer in plain words.

page.shipping.title: Shipping
page.shipping.subtitle: How fast we pack it, how long it takes, and what it costs.
page.shipping.metaDescription: CULTRAVEN shipping policy: free delivery above ₹1,999, 4 to 6 day delivery across India, tracking and Cash on Delivery.

sections.heading: Where we deliver
sections.body: We deliver across India. Enter your pincode at checkout and we will tell you straight away if we can deliver there. We do not ship outside India yet.

sections.heading: Delivery charges
sections.body:
- **Orders above ₹1,999:** delivery is free.
- **Orders of ₹1,999 or less:** a flat delivery fee of ₹99.
- **Cash on Delivery:** an extra ₹49 COD fee applies.

Every charge is shown at checkout before you place your order. There are no surprise fees later.

sections.heading: Packing time
sections.body: We pack and dispatch orders within **24 to 48 hours** on working days (Monday to Saturday). Orders placed on a Sunday or a public holiday are packed on the next working day.

sections.heading: Delivery time
sections.body: Standard delivery takes **4 to 6 business days after dispatch**. Far-away or remote pincodes can take a little longer. The delivery date we show is an estimate. Weather, strikes and courier delays can sometimes push it back.

sections.heading: Tracking your order
sections.body: We email you at every step: confirmed, packed, shipped, out for delivery and delivered. When your parcel ships, the email includes the courier name and tracking number. You can also follow your order any time in **Account → Orders**.

sections.heading: Cash on Delivery
sections.body: COD is available on orders up to ₹5,000 in the pincodes we serve. A ₹49 COD fee is added at checkout. You pay the courier when your parcel arrives. Please keep your phone on, because the courier may call you before delivery.

sections.heading: If delivery does not work out
sections.body: If nobody is available, the courier will usually try again on the next working day, and we email you when an attempt fails. After repeated failed attempts the parcel comes back to us. If you had paid online, we refund you within 5 to 7 business days. If you gave a wrong or incomplete address, we are not responsible for the failed delivery.

sections.heading: Damaged or wrong parcel
sections.body: If your parcel looks damaged or the item is not the one you ordered, please message us on WhatsApp at [+91 89622 12605](tel:+918962212605) with a photo as soon as you notice, and within 7 days of delivery. We will replace it or refund you. See [Returns & Exchanges](/pages/returns) for the full process.

page.shipping.contactText: Our team is available Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM IST.

page.returns.title: Returns & Exchanges
page.returns.subtitle: 7-day returns · 15-day size exchanges · Free pickup
page.returns.metaDescription: CULTRAVEN returns and exchanges: 7-day returns, 15-day size exchanges, free pickup and refunds in 5 to 7 business days.

steps.title: Start your return
steps.body: Sign in, open **Account → Orders**, choose the order and tap **Return / Exchange**. Tell us what is wrong.

steps.title: We arrange pickup
steps.body: Once we approve your request, we arrange a free pickup from your doorstep within 1 to 2 business days.

steps.title: We check it
steps.body: When the item reaches us, we check it within 1 to 2 business days to confirm it meets the return rules.

steps.title: Refund or exchange
steps.body: Your refund is paid within 5 to 7 business days to your original payment method. Exchanges are shipped right away.

columns.heading: What we can take back
columns.items:
The item is unworn and unwashed
Original tags are still attached
It is in its original packaging
You started the return within 7 days of delivery
It is not a sale or clearance item
It is not a custom or personalised order

columns.heading: What we cannot take back
columns.items:
Items that are worn, washed or changed in any way
Items without original tags
Sale items (marked SALE or CLEARANCE)
Custom printed or personalised products
Items returned after 7 days of delivery
Items damaged by misuse or wrong care

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body:
- We refund within **5 to 7 business days** after your item reaches us and passes the check.
- The money goes back to your **original payment method**.
- For **Cash on Delivery** orders, we will ask for your UPI ID or bank details to send the refund.
- The original delivery fee is not refunded, unless the return is because of our mistake (wrong or damaged item).

sections.heading: Size exchanges
sections.body: Wrong size? You can exchange it within **15 days of delivery**. Message us with your order number and the size you want. If that size is in stock, we send it. If it is not, you can return the item for a refund instead.

sections.heading: Damaged or wrong item
sections.body: We are sorry if this happens. Start a return from **Account → Orders** and choose *Received damaged* or *Wrong item received*. Please also send a photo on WhatsApp at [+91 89622 12605](tel:+918962212605) so we can speed up your replacement or refund.

sections.heading: Sale and clearance items
sections.body: Items marked **SALE** or **CLEARANCE** cannot be returned or exchanged. If a sale item arrives damaged or wrong, tell us and we will sort it out.

sections.heading: Want to cancel instead?
sections.body: If your order has not been delivered yet, you can cancel it from **Account → Orders** within 7 days of ordering. See our [Terms & Conditions](/pages/terms) for how cancellation works.

page.returns.contactText: Go to My Orders to start a return. Stuck? Message us and we will help.
